<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-0313-58-02" status="finalized">dang po ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang</rs></note><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha <expan>cig</expan></rs> na re shes bya'i tha snyad la blo'i yul rung gis shes bya'i tha snyad du mtshon pa'i 
               <lb n="22a9"/> tshe mtshan gzhi dang mtshon bya ldog pa mtshungs | tshul 3 la de nyid kyis rtags kyi tha snyad du mtshon pa'i tshe mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid ldog pa mtshungs so | mngon gyur gyi tha nyad la myong ba'i rtog bya bkag pas mngon gyur ma yin pa'i tha snyad du mtshon pa'i tshe gzhi mtshon 2 po ldog pa 'gal ba yin | ba lang gi don ldog chos 3 tshang ba la            
            <pb n="22b"/>          
               <lb n="22b1"/> de nyid bkag pas ba lang gi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> ma yin par mtshon pa'i tshe | gzhi mtshan 2 po ldog pa 'gal ba yin zer | 2 pa ni de dag rigs pa ma yin te sbyor ba dang po yang gzhi mtshon 2 po mtshungs mtshungs 'dra ste mi mtshungs gzhan ldog nges pa'i blo la ltos pa'i shes bya'i tha snyad mtshan gzhi yin la | rang ldog nges pa'i blo la ltos pa'i shes bya'i tha
               <lb n="22b2"/> snyad mtshon bya yin pa'i <expan>phyir ro</expan> | | 2 pa yang tshul 3 gyi bye brag mtshan gzhi yin la spyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> yin pas mi mtshungs so | 3 pa yang sngon po la ltos pa'i mngon gyur gyi tha snyad mtshan gzhi mngon gyur gyi tha snyad rang ldog la ltos pa'i de ma yin gyi tha snyad mtshon bya yin pas mi 'gal la | bzhi pa yang nog shal la ltos pa'i ba lang gi don
               <lb n="22b3"/> ldog chos 3 mtshan gzhi chos 3 rang ldog la ltos pa'i ba lang gi don ldog chos 3 bkag pa <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> yin pas 'gal ba med do ||| </seg></TEI>
